title: IdeaSeek paper compile report (paper-compile-v1)
description: Structural contract for the CompileReport that src/paper/compile.ts compileManuscript returns at every exit and `paper compile` persists to reports/paper/compile-report.json. Checked structurally: the tri-state status union the TS type enumerates, that every outcome carries the whole field set a reader indexes (engine, attempts, exitCode, logTail, blockers, provenance), and the one cross-field invariant every write site keeps — a report claiming compiled carries the PDF path and the exit code. Left in the domain module on purpose: which blocker a failing log means (classifyCompileFailure), redaction of the log tail, the page count scraped out of compile.log, whether the vendored template exists, and the figure cross-check (unapprovedFigureIncludes reads reports/paper/figure-render.json) — those are judgement and filesystem facts, not shape. Nothing here constrains how long a log tail or how many blockers a report may carry.
